import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    g=p[0]+p[1]*t**2
    return g*P*np.log(np.abs(p[2])/P) + p[3]*P + p[4]*P**2 + p[5]*P**3 + p[6] + p[7]*t**2*P**2 + p[8]*t**2*P**3 + p[9]*t**2
